title: Overconfidence in Probability Distributions: People Know They Don’t Know but They Don’t Know What to Do About It
authors: Jack B. Soll; Asa B. Palley; Joshua Klayman; Don A. Moore
eligible_reason: Preregistered judgment experiments (Studies 1-4 plus a Study 3 replication) on interval and probability-distribution elicitation. Regressions (Study3analysis.R, Study4analysis.R) are lm() of calibration measures on randomized format x judgment type x confidence. No panel, no treatment timing, no DiD.
design_notes: Participant-level and trial-level experimental data with data dictionaries; OSF preregistration referenced.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: randomized experiments, cross-sectional OLS/means; not DiD
